newsitem.title: USA: Abraxas Petroleum sees production rising.
newsitem.headline: Abraxas Petroleum sees production rising.

text.p: Abraxas Petroleum Corp on Monday estimated that its average daily production for the second quarter of 1997 would come to about 15,032 barrels of oil equivalent per day, up from a 1997 first quarter average daily production of 14,213 barrels.
In addition, Abraxas said it had drilled, or is currently drilling, 32 out of 76 wells targeted for the year.

"As of June 30, the company spent about 54 percent of its $37 million capital expenditure budget allocated for the year," said Chief Executive Bob Watson. "The company is well-financed to complete plans ahead for 1997," he added.
